test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who dies for a noble cause
solution:
The correct answer is '**Martyr**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Martyr**'.
 
• It means 'a person who suffers very much or is killed because of their religious or political beliefs, and is often admired because of it (एक व्यक्ति जो अपने धार्मिक या राजनीतिक विश्वासों के कारण बहुत अधिक पीड़ित होता है या मारा जाता है, और अक्सर इसके कारण उसकी प्रशंसा की जाती है)
 
 
• *Example: a Christian/Islamic/religious **martyr**...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Martyr.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Heretic**: a person whose religious beliefs are believed to be wrong or evil. (ऐसा व्‍यक्ति जिसके धार्मिक विश्‍वास अस्‍वीकार्य या सदोष माने गए हों; विधर्मी, अधर्मी)
 
• **Butcher**: a person who sells meat. (क़साई, मांस-विक्रेता)
 
• **Narcissist**: a person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसकी स्वयं में अत्यधिक रुचि या प्रशंसा हो)
